run_mask_matrix_nms_gaussian: run mask_matrix_nms with gaussian kernel to apply matrix NMS on multi-class instance segmentation masks
run_mask_matrix_nms_linear: run mask_matrix_nms with linear kernel to apply matrix NMS on multi-class instance segmentation masks
run_mask_matrix_nms_with_filter: run mask_matrix_nms with a score filter threshold to discard low-scoring masks after NMS
run_mask_matrix_nms_with_nms_pre: run mask_matrix_nms with nms_pre to limit the number of masks processed before NMS
run_mask_matrix_nms_with_max_num: run mask_matrix_nms with max_num to cap the final number of remaining masks after NMS
